## Nightly Tests

Trigger nightly test workflows via slash commands.

| 命令 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `/nightly <test_cases> --aop_enabled` | 启用 AOP pipeline |
| `/nightly <test_cases>` | 运行标准 nightly 测试 |
